<h4 id="gettaskversiondatatasktaskschedulerconfigurationupstreamdependencyconfiglistdependencystrategy">Get<wbr>Task<wbr>Version<wbr>Data<wbr>Task<wbr>Task<wbr>Scheduler<wbr>Configuration<wbr>Upstream<wbr>Dependency<wbr>Config<wbr>List<wbr>Dependency<wbr>Strategy</h4>



<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="csharp">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="pollingnullstrategy_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#pollingnullstrategy_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Polling<wbr>Null<wbr>Strategy</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Wait upstream task instance policy: EXECUTING (execute); WAITING (wait).</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="taskdependencyexecutingstrategies_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#taskdependencyexecutingstrategies_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Task<wbr>Dependency<wbr>Executing<wbr>Strategies</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;string&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd><p>This field is required only when PollingNullStrategy is set to EXECUTING.
Type: List</p>
<p>NOT_EXIST (default) - In cases where minute depends on minute / hour depends on hour, the parent instance does not fall within the scheduling time range of the downstream instance.</p>
<p>PARENT_EXPIRED - The parent instance failed.</p>
<p>PARENT_TIMEOUT - The parent instance timed out.</p>
<p>If any of the above conditions are met, the dependency check for that parent task instance is considered satisfied. In all other cases, the system must wait for the parent instance.</p>
</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="taskdependencyexecutingtimeoutvalue_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#taskdependencyexecutingtimeoutvalue_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Task<wbr>Dependency<wbr>Executing<wbr>Timeout<wbr>Value</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">int</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>This field is required only when TaskDependencyExecutingStrategies includes PARENT_TIMEOUT.
Specifies the timeout duration (in minutes) for the downstream task's dependency on the parent instance execution.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>
